nodes.description: Public string constant identifying the token standard ('LottoToken').
uint MaxRand = 1000, upper bound used to shape the random reward.
Minimum ETH required to buy a ticket; incremented after every purchase.
Token amount required to exchange a ticket (100 * 10**18).
Payable address that receives withdrawn ETH.
Address holding the team reserve tokens minted at deploy/game end.
Total ETH collected through ticket sales and available for withdrawal.
Mapping(gameId => account => balance) holding the balances.
Mapping(gameId => owner => spender => allowance).
Mapping(gameId => total supply).
Current game id used as the namespace index for balances, allowances and supply.
Owner address checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pause flag checked before every token transfer.
Caller address, used as ticket buyer/exchanger and as the owner check source.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as the randomness seed and game-end trigger.
External payable ticket purchase: takes ETH, pays out a timestamp-derived random token reward and raises MinBuyAmount.
Public function that burns MinExchangeAmount tokens and pays a timestamp-derived random reward.
Owner-only setter for the payout wallet address.
Owner-only function that sends ETH to wallet using a low-level call.
Private view returning keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty) % MaxRand + 1 scaled by 1e18.
Internal hook that, on a timestamp/difficulty condition, advances _gameId and mints new tokens.
Initializes token metadata, wallet, team reserve and mints the initial supply.
Internal balance-moving routine used by transfer/transferFrom/BuyTicket/ExchangeTicket.
Internal mint that increases total supply and credits a balance.
Internal burn that debits a balance and decreases total supply.
Internal allowance setter.
ERC20 transfer entry point that delegates to _transfer with _msgSender().
ERC20 transferFrom entry point that transfers and decrements the allowance.
ERC20 approve entry point that delegates to _approve.
Internal function that increments _gameId using SafeMath.add.
Ownership guard modifier comparing _owner to _msgSender().
Low-level wallet.call{value: amount}("") external ETH transfer performed with state already updated.
Randomness computed from block.timestamp and block.difficulty modulo MaxRand (miner manipulable).
Game-end condition based on keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty) % 10000 == 1 (miner manipulable).
MinBuyAmount = MinBuyAmount + 0.00001 ether performed with plain unchecked addition (Solidity 0.7.0).
MinExchangeAmount.add(1) computed but the result is discarded, so the state never changes.
Amount of wei requested in withdraw.
New payout wallet address passed to changeWallet.
Initial payout wallet passed to the LottoToken constructor.
Team reserve address passed to the LottoToken constructor.
Debited address in _transfer.
Credited address in _transfer.
Token amount moved by _transfer.
Beneficiary address in _mint.
Token amount created by _mint.
Address whose tokens are destroyed in _burn.
Token amount destroyed by _burn.
Local uint256 rand holding the timestamp-derived reward before transfer.

edges.reason: BuyTicket uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the ticket buyer and reward recipient.
ExchangeTicket reads balanceOf(_msgSender()) and burns the caller's tokens.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender(), the access-control subject.
random() derives its output from block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
_gameEndCheck uses block.timestamp in its keccak condition.
random() body contains the timestamp/difficulty modulo randomness computation.
_gameEndCheck body contains the timestamp/difficulty modulo game-end test.
BuyTicket calls random() to compute the reward.
ExchangeTicket calls random() to compute the reward.
BuyTicket consumes miner-manipulable timestamp randomness when paying out.
ExchangeTicket consumes miner-manipulable timestamp randomness when paying out.
BuyTicket calls _gameEndCheck with its timestamp-dependent game-end test.
ExchangeTicket calls _gameEndCheck with its timestamp-dependent game-end test.
BuyTicket executes MinBuyAmount + 0.00001 ether without overflow checking.
The unchecked addition writes the MinBuyAmount state variable.
ExchangeTicket calls MinExchangeAmount.add(1) and discards the returned value.
The discarded SafeMath add is intended to modify MinExchangeAmount but never does.
BuyTicket reads and updates MinBuyAmount (require plus increment).
BuyTicket accumulates msg.value into weiRaised.
BuyTicket transfers the reward through _transfer.
BuyTicket pays the reward to _msgSender().
ExchangeTicket burns the caller's tokens via _burn.
ExchangeTicket pays the reward through _transfer.
ExchangeTicket reads MinExchangeAmount in its balance requirement.
withdraw performs the low-level ETH transfer to wallet.
The external call to wallet can re-enter withdraw before/while funds are sent.
The attacker-controllable wallet address is the destination of the external call.
withdraw checks and decreases weiRaised before the external call.
withdraw is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeWallet is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeWallet writes the wallet state variable.
onlyOwner reads _owner for the access-control comparison.
The constructor mints the initial supplies via _mint.
The constructor assigns the wallet state variable.
The constructor assigns the teamReserve state variable.
_gameEndCheck advances the game by calling _incraseGameId.
_gameEndCheck mints new token batches on game end.
_gameEndCheck mints the team share to teamReserve.
_gameEndCheck (through _incraseGameId) mutates _gameId.
_transfer reads and writes _balances.
_transfer indexes _balances with _gameId and applies SafeMath sub/add on balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply for the current game.
_mint credits the recipient balance.
_burn debits the account balance.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve writes the allowances mapping.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the movement to _transfer.
transferFrom updates the allowance via _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
transfer moves tokens from _msgSender().
withdraw sends funds to the wallet address.
weiRaised is consumed by the withdraw requirement and decrement.

normalization_plan.reason: The withdraw amount parameter only exists to feed the withdraw function's balance check and external value transfer.
The _newWallet parameter is only a placeholder for the wallet assignment performed by changeWallet.
The constructor _wallet parameter is only used to initialize the wallet state variable during construction.
The constructor _teamReserve parameter is only used to initialize teamReserve and the mint target during construction.
The sender parameter only exists to index the balances mapping inside _transfer.
The recipient parameter only exists to index the balances mapping inside _transfer.
The amount parameter only feeds the SafeMath balance arithmetic inside _transfer.
The account parameter is only the mint beneficiary handled by _mint.
The amount parameter only feeds the supply/balance updates inside _mint.
The account parameter is only the burn source handled by _burn.
The amount parameter only feeds the balance/supply updates inside _burn.
The local rand in BuyTicket is merely a temporary alias for the value returned by the timestamp-based random() call.
